record.paper_title: Problemas abiertos en series de Fourier de Jacobi-Sobolev
record.context_brief: Kernel estimates for non-discrete Jacobi-Sobolev polynomials
record.original_question: For the Jacobi-Sobolev polynomials Q_n in the non-discrete Sobolev inner product with two continuous measures, obtain estimates for the kernel L_n(x,y)=sum_{k=0}^n Q_k^*(x)Q_k^*(y), where Q_k^* is the orthonormal sequence corresponding to Q_k.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $d\mu_0$ and $d\mu_1$ be two positive Borel measures on the real line (both absolutely continuous with respect to Lebesgue measure on a common interval, e.g. Jacobi-type weights $(1-x)^{\alpha_i}(1+x)^{\beta_i}$ on $[-1,1]$ with $\alpha_i,\beta_i>-1$), and consider the non-discrete Sobolev inner product
$$\langle f,g\rangle_S \;=\; \int f(x)\,g(x)\,d\mu_0(x) \;+\; \int f'(x)\,g'(x)\,d\mu_1(x).$$
Let $\{Q_n\}_{n\ge 0}$ denote the monic polynomials orthogonal with respect to $\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_S$, and let $\{Q_n^{*}\}_{n\ge 0}$ be the corresponding orthonormal sequence, i.e. $Q_n^{*}=Q_n/\|Q_n\|_S$. Define the reproducing kernel
$$L_n(x,y) \;=\; \sum_{k=0}^{n} Q_k^{*}(x)\,Q_k^{*}(y).$$
Obtain sharp asymptotic estimates (pointwise on the diagonal $x=y$, off-diagonal, and locally uniform on appropriate compact subsets of the complex plane) for $L_n(x,y)$ as $n\to\infty$ in this non-discrete Jacobi–Sobolev setting.
artifact.status_search_result: The question of sharp kernel asymptotics for orthonormal polynomials with respect to a non-discrete Jacobi–Sobolev inner product with two continuous measures does not appear to be resolved in the available literature. Existing works (e.g. asymptotic properties of polynomials orthogonal with respect to non-discrete Jacobi–Sobolev inner products, and classical Sobolev orthogonal polynomial studies) address outer/Mehler–Heine type asymptotics and zero distributions, but kernel-type estimates $L_n(x,y)$ in this non-discrete continuous-continuous setting appear to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Asymptotic Properties of Orthogonal Polynomials with Respect to a Non-discrete Jacobi-Sobolev Inner Product
status_evidence.snippet: Study of polynomials orthogonal with respect to the non-discrete Sobolev inner product involving Jacobi-type measures with continuous components.
status_evidence.claim: Existing asymptotic results in this setting address polynomial asymptotics but not kernel estimates.

status_evidence.title: Classical Sobolev orthogonal polynomials: eigenvalue analysis
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses asymptotic behavior in Sobolev orthogonality but does not provide kernel estimates for the non-discrete two-continuous-measure Jacobi case.
status_evidence.claim: Kernel asymptotics for the non-discrete Jacobi-Sobolev kernel are not established here.
